findings.message: The state-line text is truncated. It reads 'At' at launch and at the top, and 'Risin' while rising. The traced motionState values are 'At launch', 'Rising', 'At the top' and 'Back at start'. 'At' at launch and 'At' at the top are identical, so the two states can't be told apart. The state line is part of the required motionState readout and the 'At top' control, so this is a defect.

The acceleration arrow is 13.6 px long at g=4 and 33.3 px at g=9.8, so it scales with g (about 3.4 px per m/s²). This is consistent. The callout boxes are drawn as boxes with no text in the frame, so the velocity, acceleration and force readings in the callout can't be verified from the frames. Frames can't show whether the callout wording is correct.

At the top the velocity arrow is correctly absent, and the acceleration arrow is still drawn at -g. The ball height, 226.09 px, agrees with the traced apex height of 1.2755 m. The checkpoints are otherwise supported. The 'before' checkpoint has v=0.98 and the correct height of 1.2265 m. The heavy-mass capture has force 49 N with identical motion. The fast-toss capture has apex time 2.5 s and apex height 12.5 m. The Launch Mark text and the vector labels are consistent with the traces.
